newsitem.title: HONG KONG: APT Satellite eases in thin early trade.
newsitem.headline: APT Satellite eases in thin early trade.

text.p: Shares of APT Satellite Holdings Ltd fell over five percent to hit a low of HK$11.80 in Friday morning trade on lack of buying interest, brokers said.
The satellite services provider later recovered to HK$12.10, down HK$0.40, around mid-morning, but remained well below its issue price of HK$13.40.

Local investors were not familiar with the satellite business and the shares' public offering was under subscribed, so after the shares were listed on Wednesday there was not much trading interest, said Antony Mak of Vickers Ballas.
APT's public offering was 65.5 percent subscribed, and its price was fixed below a target range of HK$15.31-17.71 a share.
